# Sarah

## Overview

- **Age:** 8 years old (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Sarah is a large, sleek, gray-and-white cat who possesses an enormous dignity. She is also described as having thin cheeks that can show a proud flush.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)_

## Personality

Sarah is an eight-year-old, gray-and-white cat who possesses an enormous dignity despite her plebeian origin. A remarkable mouser, she maintains a peaceful demeanor and never fights.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)_

## History

Twenty years prior, Sarah was prevented by her father from marrying Luther Wallace because he was poor, leading her to whitewash her duckhouse every spring in case it might be needed. Years later, she rescued [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) crashed through her duckhouse roof while trying to look for a blue willow-ware platter. Sarah hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for tea, complained about her sister Martha, and agreed to sell the platter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for twenty-five dollars to help fund her upcoming marriage. Later, a cat named the Sarah-cat, who had been given to [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) by her washerwoman, lived alongside [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) at Patty's Place.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P2](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0002), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P4](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0004), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P5](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0005), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P6](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0006), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P7](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0007), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P8](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0008), +157 more_

> “Miss Copp,” she said earnestly. “I assure you I looked into your pantry window only to discover if you had a willow-ware platter. I didn’t see anything else—I didn’t look for anything else.”
>
> — Sarah — [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P56](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0056)

> "I don’t know as I mind selling the platter. But it’s worth twenty-five dollars. It’s a very old platter."
>

> "Just a month. Thomas courted me for quite a spell, though. It was real romantic."

> "Well, y’see, he didn’t love me"

> "Are you the new Valley Road schoolma’am?"

## Relationships

### [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-ann--sarah.md)

During a drive to drop [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) off at her new boarding house, Sarah entertains her passenger with stories about her romantic choices, her husband, and her cousin [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md).
